coreIntegrityQuestion.question: Can the earner write a USDC number that did not come from a genuine, FINALIZED, external on-chain payment?
coreIntegrityQuestion.basis: On the prod path (FOUNDER_TEST unset) every seam (FOUNDER_DIR/LEDGER/WALLET/CURSOR/BLOCK_NOW/LOGS_JSON/RAW_LOGS_JSON/BASE_RPC_URL/HOME) is TEST-gated (record-earn.mjs:14,20,24,38,56,63,89,91,109); blockNow() reads the FINALIZED head only (record-earn.mjs:67-69) so the cursor never advances past un-finalized blocks; externalInflow scans cursor+1..finalizedHead and the cursor is written to finalizedHead (record-earn.mjs:119-120) — both bounded by finality, no reorg window; parseRawLogs re-verifies address==USDC, topic0==Transfer, to==founder locally (record-earn.mjs:83-84) and sumExternal drops from in MY_WALLETS (record-earn.mjs:74); wallet is pinned to 0x810f (record-earn.mjs:42). FIND-601/602/603 are CLOSED. The FAILs below are MINOR non-integrity hardening/coverage gaps, none of which permits a fabricated or inflated USDC number (all fail-closed or under-count).
